flags.message: Frozen context reports amicus_briefs=2 while the snapshot shows five amicus filings: interim_signals._AMICUS_RE matches the singular 'amicus curiae' only, so the three entries styled 'amici curiae' (56 Former Judges; Bipartisan Former Governors; Asian Law Caucus, et al.) are not counted. Internally consistent for the amicus-increment claim (the same counter resolves it), but the count understates amicus interest on any docket where filers docket in the plural form, which is most multi-filer briefs.

Three of the five amicus entries carry 'VIDED', which normally marks a filing docketed across companion applications, yet the snapshot's RelatedCaseNumber is empty and a metadata-restricted CourtListener search surfaced no companion SCOTUS application from the federal defendants. Whether the enjoined federal parties have a parallel application materially affects this application's grant probability; the record available to this cell cannot resolve it.
